notes.content: The page continues a claim of geometric connectedness for every linear subvariety under properness, then states Corollaire 5 claiming surjectivity of a fundamental-group homomorphism. Théorème 6 sets up k algebraically closed, X proper, f to projective space, a linear L_t, and a closed D. Conditions a)–c) concern nonemptiness, local smoothness/codimension and netness, and either codimension at least two or a local divisor inducing normal crossings. The final paragraph defines tame fundamental-group quotients and ends in the unfinished word homomor-. These are document claims, not verified theorems.
notes.coverage: All 28 physical body lines, the interline additions, three margin rules, marginal reference, local nonverbal points and archive number were read against both witnesses. Agreed words, accents, endings, punctuation and formulas were checked against the two once-viewed halves; open places received exactly one saved crop each.
notes.written_reservations: There is no separate prose doubt or objection on this page. Corrections/cancellations and the marginal cf. reference are preserved. The unexpected danonique, sous -espace, net and cancelled grou are retained from their letter contours. The two cells before X in condition c) remain mixed e/s and n/u.
notes.mathematical_considerations: The positions of indices, arrows, the cancelled relation in a), the codimension object/relation and tame-quotient arguments directed local inspection. No symbol was decided from the desired mathematical statement. The slanted lower stroke decides geqslant; this changes shape but not the inequality. No proof verification was performed.
notes.double_star: Crop c03 shows two cells with diagonal rays and central horizontal strokes, supporting the agreed (**); no collation difference was made.
notes.chronology: No ordered replacement is assigned to the composite reference numeral, mixed word cells or final U/V cell. Explicit x cancellation and the recognizably cancelled typed objects under freehand Y are recorded as visible deletion states.
notes.emphasis_conventions: H emph around toute is treated as equivalent to the single underline. Heading differences concern the visible extent of emphasis and punctuation spacing, not bold versus underline macro syntax alone.
notes.page_boundary: The final hyphen is retained on this independent one-page reading. No text from a following page was supplied; the parent may join the word when transcribing its actual continuation.
input_limitations: The prior-question explanation for the numeral says: “Same composite numeral family as the previous page; both shapes retained.” That cross-page analogy was ignored; only this page supplied reading evidence.
The provided H extraction has no archive-page macro. Per the brief, this is not reported as an H omission.
Two points below the corrected codimension glyph are preserved without assigning textual purpose or maker.
notes.workflow: No OCR, text extraction, recognition library, external research, other-page image, other-reader record, or further agent was used. Whole and each half were each viewed exactly once. Nineteen open-place crops were made once and viewed once, with no recropping or re-opening of halves.
